plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Venturi Wireless optimisation servers (enterprise PEN 3382, VENTURI-SERVER-STATS-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB interface traffic and uptime, it reports overall CPU utilisation and Venturi buffer (VBuf) pool usage.
name: Wanopt

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the Venturi Wireless optimisation server since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Overall CPU utilisation of the Venturi Wireless optimisation server (VENTURI-SERVER-STATS-MIB vServerCpuUtilization) as a 0-100 percentage.

metrics.name: venturi_vbuf_usage_percent
metrics.description: Venturi buffer pool usage as a 0-100 percentage, derived from VENTURI-SERVER-STATS-MIB vServerStatsSystemUsedVenturiBuffers / vServerSystemTotalVenturiBuffers.
